source_filename_note: manifest.json 保留原始 artifact 的源路径和源文件名，用于哈希追溯；个别源文件名包含早期批次 token，这些 token 只是历史文件名的一部分，不改变本清单以 support_level=strong_evidence 为准的正文证据级别。
source_reference_note: Public manifests use ap-paper-artifacts:// and ap-prototype:// logical source URIs. They identify original experiment branches or prototype-relative files without exposing a local drive path. SHA-256 values are computed over the copied public files listed by target.
manifest_integrity_note: The root manifest was refreshed after adding the AP prototype reproduction delta, E08 criterion clarification, citation metadata, GitHub release checklist, and release helper scripts; listed bytes and SHA-256 values refer to the files as published in this attachment repository.

prototype_delta.scope_note: Minimal AP prototype delta for full E01-E17 reproduction; excludes local outputs, frontend build artifacts, PA/NapCat helper scripts, and unrelated dirty worktree files.

github_release_note: The local repository is release-ready. If no remote is configured, use GITHUB_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md or scripts/publish_to_github.ps1 after creating the GitHub repository.
